chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub al-Khazzaz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

One of our companions asked him (peace be upon him) about a Muslim man who is fascinated by the beauty of a woman, is it permissible for him to marry her while she is insane? He (peace be upon him) said: No. But if there is an insane slave girl with him, there is no problem if he copulates with her, and he should not seek her children.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a sane man to marry an insane woman according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the prohibition of marrying an insane woman is linked to the potential for hereditary transmission of insanity to offspring, a key concern in Shia jurisprudence. The hadith distinguishes this from a male slave owner having intercourse with his own insane slave girl, where the goal is merely consummation rather than procreation, thus avoiding the risk of passing on the condition. This reflects the practical legal reasoning of the Imams regarding marriage suitability and genetic health in the context of 9th-century Kufa.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazaz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

One of our companions asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the Muslim man fascinated by the beauty of the woman, is it correct for him that he marries her and she is insane?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said; ‘No, but if there was an insane slave girl with him, so there is no problem if he copulates with her, but he should not seek her children’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Certain persons of our people once asked abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about the case of a Muslim man who likes a beautiful woman; if he can marry her and she is insane. He (the Imam) said, ’No, however, if he has an insane slave-girl he can go to bed with her but must not seek her children (he must use contraceptives).”’
